descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. While much of the industry remains in R&D, we deliver real, production-ready autonomy that is already operating in the field.

We are on a mission to make mining operations safer, smarter, and more efficient through cutting-edge technology, and we are building toward becoming the world’s first profitable AV technology company.

What You'll Do

We are seeking a Perception Engineer to develop the systems that enable our autonomous machines to understand and interact with the physical world.

You will work on perception problems at the intersection of computer vision, machine learning, robotics, and autonomous systems, building models and systems that transform real-world sensor data into reliable representations of the environment.

Depending on your background and area of expertise, you may:

  • Design, train, and deploy machine learning models for perception in autonomous systems.
  • Develop algorithms for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, and scene understanding.
  • Build systems for 3D perception and geometric reasoning using cameras, LiDAR, radar, or other sensors.
  • Develop approaches for multi-sensor and multi-modal fusion, combining complementary sensor information into robust representations of the environment.
  • Build temporal models that reason about objects, motion, trajectories, and changes in the environment over time.
  • Improve perception performance across challenging real-world conditions, including occlusion, sensor noise, changing environments, and edge cases.
  • Develop data, training, evaluation, and experimentation pipelines that accelerate perception development.
  • Define metrics and evaluation methodologies that connect offline model performance to real-world system behavior.
  • Optimize perception models and systems for deployment on resource-constrained or latency-sensitive robotic platforms.
  • Investigate failures observed in deployed systems and translate those findings into improvements across models, data, and architecture.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Research, Robotics, ML Infrastructure, Software, Hardware, and Systems Engineering teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience working with perception systems and computer vision & machine learning models.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or C++.
  • Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, robotics, drones, industrial automation, or other embodied systems.
  • Experience with camera, LiDAR, radar, IMU, or other robotic sensor modalities.
  • Experience with multi-modal or multi-sensor architectures.
  • Knowledge of 3D geometry, coordinate transformations, calibration, localization, or state estimation.
  • Experience deploying ML models into real-time or safety-critical systems.
  • Experience optimizing models for latency, compute, memory, or power constraints.
  • Experience working with large-scale perception datasets and training infrastructure.
  • Experience diagnosing long-tail failures and improving production perception systems through data-driven iteration.
  • Experience taking research ideas from experimentation through deployment on physical systems.
  • Publications or significant research contributions in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, or related fields are a plus, but not required.

Why join us

  • Work on real, production-deployed autonomy.
  • Build technology that directly improves safety, efficiency, and productivity.
  • Tackle complex challenges in demanding, real-world environments.
  • Be part of a fast-moving team with high ownership and impact.
  • See your work deployed and making a difference in the field.
  • Collaborate closely with experienced engineers and industry operators.

What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our San Francisco office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The base salary range for this role is $208,000 - $245,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees)

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account / Health Savings Account Options
  • 401(k)
  • Equity
  • Sick Time, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, and Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Benefit Plan

Benefits Are Subject To Change At The Company's Discretion.

Pronto accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

descriptionHtml:
Company Description Have you ever looked up at the cameras as you drive past an intersection and wondered what is going on behind the scenes? Whenever you pick up a rental car, do you know what happens to the pictures and videos taken by the cameras near the exit of the parking lot? Would you like to know how NCIS Special Agents track down vehicles of interest? Come find out at ALPR Solutions.

Role Description We are seeking a highly experienced computer vision expert to design, improve, optimize, and productionize advanced computer vision models and inference engines. This role sits at the intersection of deep learning research, neural network architecture, computer vision, and high-performance inference engineering. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving well beyond simply training an existing model: they can analyze network architecture at the layer and node level, experiment with model structure and activation functions, diagnose accuracy and performance issues, optimize inference pipelines, and translate research models into production-ready computer vision engines. You will work on computer vision problems involving object detection, image classification, OCR, visual embeddings, image retrieval, image similarity, attribute recognition, and multimodal / vision-language models. This position requires hands-on expertise with technologies such as PyTorch, ONNX, OpenCV, OpenVINO, CNNs, Transformers, CLIP-style models, and Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

Job Responsibilities

Neural Network Research & Architecture

  • Analyze and modify neural networks at the layer, block, channel, node, and tensor level. 
  • Experiment with network depth, width, feature dimensions, convolutional blocks, normalization strategies, residual connections, attention mechanisms, and output heads. 
  • Evaluate tradeoffs between accuracy, inference latency, model size, and memory/CPU utilization.
  • Experiment with activation functions such as ReLU, Leaky ReLU, SiLU/Swish, GELU, and others.
  • Investigate the effect of input resolution, feature-map resolution, receptive field, stride, padding, kernel size, and network capacity on model performance.

Model Training & PyTorch Development 

  • Modify models and implement custom layers, heads, loss functions, and training strategies. 
  • Analyze training behavior including convergence, overfitting, underfitting, class imbalance, hard-negative examples, and ambiguous classifications. 
  • Develop effective data augmentation, normalization, preprocessing, and sampling strategies. 
  • Perform model ablation studies to determine which changes materially improve performance. 
  • Diagnose model confusion between visually similar classes (such as side-profile GMC Yukon versus Chevy Tahoe) and develop techniques to improve discriminative capability.

OpenCV & Image Processing

  • Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision pipelines using OpenCV. 
  • Implement preprocessing and post-processing including resizing, cropping, normalization, filtering, geometric transformations, color-space conversion, thresholding, image enhancement. 
  • Understand the effect of interpolation, compression, image format, resolution on model accuracy. 
  • Diagnose discrepancies caused by differences between training and production image pipelines.

Object Detection, Classification & OCR 

  • Develop and improve models for: object detection, image classification, fine-grained visual classification, OCR / text recognition, attribute classification, region classification 
  • Work with architectures such as YOLO and other modern CNN/Transformer-based detectors. 
  • Research OCR architectures such as CTC-based and sequence-based recognition models.
  • Analyze character-level confusion (such as “O” vs. “0”) and difficult visual cases. 
  • Tune OCR network architecture, feature extraction, sequence length, decoding, and training data.
  • Develop methods for handling ambiguous characters, unusual layouts, stacked characters, low-resolution images, blur, glare, weather conditions, poor illumination, and image compression.

ONNX & Model Interoperability

  • Export and convert PyTorch models to ONNX for deployment, considering ONNX computational graphs, operators, tensors, shapes, dynamic/static dimensions, and opset compatibility. 
  • Validate model outputs across PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, C++, and other inference environments to diagnose model conversion problems and any differences in inference. 
  • Optimize ONNX graphs, including operator fusion, constant folding, and graph simplification.
  • Identify unsupported operators and redesign or replace network components when necessary.

Embeddings, CLIP & Image Search

  • Evaluate embedding architectures and vector databases for visual search/similarity use cases.
  • Work with CLIP, SigLIP, MobileCLIP, EVA-CLIP, and related multimodal embedding architectures. 
  • Benchmark embedding models for retrieval accuracy, mAP, Recall@K, F1, ROC/AUC, embedding quality, NDCG, inference latency, model size, and CPU/GPU requirements.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs between general-purpose foundation versus domain-specific embeddings. 
  • Develop similarity search and nearest neighbor retrieval capable of operating at billion-plus scale.

Vision-Language Models & Foundation Models 

  • Evaluate emerging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and multimodal foundation models. 
  • Experiment with models such as Qwen-VL, Florence, and other sota vision architectures to evaluate whether they can supplement or replace traditional task-specific CV models. 
  • Develop approaches for zero-shot / few-shot classification, visual question answering, image understanding, semantic image search, automatic labeling, object and attribute extraction.
  • Adapt large pretrained models to ALPR use cases through fine-tuning, distillation, adapters.
  • Track emerging research and determine which techniques have practical production value.

Productionization & Computer Vision Engine Development 

  • Work with software engineers to integrate nnet models into high-volume production systems. 
  • Design reusable computer vision inference components, APIs, and microservices. 
  • Optimize models where latency, throughput, memory/CPU constraints, and reliability are critical. 
  • Maintain compatibility across model versions, inference runtimes, and hardware platforms. 
  • Participate in model versioning, regression testing, performance benchmarking, and hypercare.

Desired Attributes

  • Eye for design, care for security, and optimization for performance
  • Self-starter with the demonstrated aptitude to be self-sufficient 
  • Proven ability to effectively deliver on objectives 
  • Works well under the pressure of a deadline and prides him/herself on delivering on time
  • Strong desire to be successful and confident in one’s own success

Hybrid Work and Flexibility

On average, the ALPR Solutions team works on-site 3 days each week at our office at 12610 Race Track Road, Tampa, Florida 33626. We are interviewing candidates on-site every Wednesday. Candidates must be located within daily commuting distance to Tampa, Florida, or be ready to relocate at their expense. We prioritize candidates with high volume live streaming data experience.

companyDescription: Powerus is a US-owned defense and autonomy company focused on building and scaling real-world capability, not concepts. We design, develop, and deploy unmanned systems that perform where it matters, combining advanced engineering with rapid execution and reliable delivery. With a platform-led approach and growing portfolio, we operate across defense, critical infrastructure, and autonomous operations, bringing together technology, manufacturing, and commercial expertise to move faster and deliver at scale.
companySlogan: Building and scaling real-world autonomous capability for defense and critical infrastructure.
descriptionHtml:
About Powerus


Powerus is building a next-generation American autonomous systems platform designed to move, protect, and sustain critical assets in high-consequence environments. The company combines advanced autonomy, manufacturing capability, operational expertise, and strategic acquisitions to support defense, national security, critical infrastructure, and commercial operations globally.


Mission


Our mission is to deliver resilient autonomous technologies that strengthen national security, improve operational safety, and expand the capabilities of organizations operating in complex environments.


Why Join Powerus


Powerus aircraft carry electro-optical and infrared cameras that operators use to find, identify, and follow objects of interest. The processing that turns those images into detections and tracks runs on the aircraft, within tight limits on compute, power, and latency.


This role develops and deploys the vision algorithms that run onboard, and verifies them against real flight imagery across lighting, weather, and sensor conditions.


Position Overview


Powerus is seeking a Computer Vision Engineer to develop onboard detection, tracking, and image processing for EO/IR sensors on autonomous aircraft.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop object detection, multi-object tracking, and target re-acquisition for EO and IR imagery
  • Implement image stabilization, registration, and geolocation of detections
  • Optimize vision pipelines for embedded GPUs and accelerators
  • Integrate vision outputs with autonomy, payload control, and ground station displays
  • Evaluate algorithm performance on recorded flight data and define acceptance metrics
  • Support flight test and data collection

Qualifications


  • Must be located in the United States, within commuting distance of Rock Hill, SC
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • Professional experience developing computer vision software in C++ and Python
  • Experience with OpenCV and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch
  • Experience with object detection and tracking algorithms
  • Working knowledge of camera models, calibration, and multi-view geometry
  • Experience deploying vision software on embedded or real-time systems
  • U.S. Person status required (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)); this role involves access to ITAR- and EAR-controlled technical data

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, or CUDA
  • Experience with infrared imagery
  • Experience with aerial or overhead imagery
  • Graduate degree in computer vision, robotics, or a related field
  • Active or prior U.S. security clearance

What We Look For


Candidates should have deployed a vision algorithm on hardware that operated outside a lab and be able to describe how its performance was measured.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Powerus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and mission-driven workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Job description:

Perception AI/ML Software Engineer

Hyundai America Technical Center, Inc. (HATCI) is seeking an engineer to join the Perception and Data Team of the Autonomous Driving Software Department

The Team:

The Autonomous Driving Software Department is an engineering and data science team that focuses on improving performance and expanding ADAS features and services concerning Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis vehicles for the North American (NA) market. Autonomous Driving Software oversees efforts pertaining to the following areas:

  • New Technology Introduction: Spearhead new technology conceptualization for future-generation ADAS/AD experiences for the NA market through in-house development as well as strategic partnerships with key technology partners, such as universities, automotive suppliers, startups, and research labs
  • Software Development: Expand Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis ADAS/AD capabilities in coordination with R&D headquarters and other internal/external project partners
  • Prototyping and Demonstration: Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept demonstrations for various global teams within Hyundai Motor Group for new ADAS/AD functions targeted for the NA market
  • Software Strategy and Planning: Identify market trends and customer needs for key ADAS/AD experience themes and selection of new concept ideas
  • Data Collection and Curation for Production Applications: Support development of data-driven machine learning models with NA data

The Position:

The Perception AI/ML Software Engineer would support computer vision and deep learning efforts for autonomous driving perception applications, developing, optimizing, and evaluating AI/ML models to interpret real-world driving environments, as well as contributing to and leading data acquisition, processing, curation, and analysis for visual AI workflows

What You Will Do:
  • Design, train, and evaluate computer vision AI models for perception tasks, such as object detection, classification, instance segmentation, and other similar tasks, using real-world and synthetically-generated data
  • Develop Python, MATLAB, and/or C++ tools for model training, evaluation, deployment, and visualization workflows
  • Work with large-scale datasets, including maintaining and updating said datasets to support expansion to broader operational design domains
  • Develop and train CNN-based, transformer-based, and multimodal AI models for ADAS/AD perception tasks
  • Adapt and fine-tune pretrained and foundation models for automotive applications using transfer learning and domain adaptation
  • Optimize and deploy ML/CV models for real-time in-vehicle inference and offline AI data-engine workflows
  • Develop AI-driven data-processing workflows and tools for autolabeling, coreset selection, hard-example mining, and corner-case detection
  • Run model evaluations and validations, perform quantitative performance analyses, and conduct robustness and generalization tests to comply with internal ODDs
  • Perform small-scale, in-house data annotations to develop experience-driven data annotation policies
  • Collaborate with software engineers to deploy trained models on embedded hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Orin/Thor Edge devices)
  • Evaluate and test models in real-world environments with prototype vehicles
  • Prepare technical documentation and clearly communicate model development efforts, including sharing the background, progress, results, and next steps, with the relevant stakeholders
  • Travel occasionally to interface with technical experts and project partners at the Hyundai Motor Company Advanced Vehicle Platform Headquarters in South Korea
What You Will Bring to the Role:
  • Basic Qualifications:
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, robotics, artificial intelligence, or a related field
    • Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.)
    • Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including model training, validation, metrics, evaluation, and deployment
    • Experience with open-source vision toolboxes and libraries (e.g., OpenCV, OpenMMLab, Ultralytics, Hugging Face, etc.)
    • Proficiency in Python
    • Familiarity with C++
    • Ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Excellent time management, self-management, project management, and organization skills
    • Strong written, oral, and interpersonal skills
  • Preferred Qualifications:
    • Master’s degree in computer science, robotics, artificial intelligence, or a related field
    • Professional (e.g., internship, co-op, etc.), research, and/or student-team experience related to robotics, autonomous systems, and/or ADAS, with a focus on perception/vision
    • Expertise in vision/multimodal tasks for ADAS and/or robotic perception, such as object detection, depth estimation, instance segmentation, multi-object tracking, etc.
    • Experience deploying models in Edge devices (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson devices) and converting models across frameworks (e.g., MMDet, ONNX, TensorRT, etc.)
    • Familiarity with embedded optimization concepts, such as model compression, quantization, and inference acceleration for automotive hardware
    • Experience creating publications (e.g., patents, libraries, conference proceedings, and/or peer-reviewed journals)
    • Experience working on single and multi-camera systems (i.e., multi-view geometry)
    • Familiarity with sensor calibration and synchronization workflows
What Hyundai Can Offer You:
  • Zero-dollar Employee Premiums on Medical, Dental, and Vision for You and Your Family
  • 100% Employer-paid Disability and Life Insurance
  • Generous Paid Time Off, Including Vacation, Sick, and Abundant Holidays
  • Competitive Salaries
  • A Global Environment that Fosters Diversity
  • Retirement Savings and Planning Benefits
  • Vehicle Fuel Allowance
  • Vehicle Lease Allowance
  • Access to Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts 
  • Flexible Work Hours
Other Details:
  • Candidates applying for positions with Hyundai KIA must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.
    • HATCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Disabled and Veteran. VEVRAA Federal contractor.

Job Description Summary

As a Computer Vision Senior Engineer/Scientist, you will join a multi-disciplinary research team developing and maturing advanced computer vision and autonomous solutions for manufacturing and field services across GE Vernova. In this role, you may define vision system architectures, develop advanced algorithms, integrate complex imaging sensors, and implement robust machine learning models to deliver automated inspection, field services, and mission-critical robotics capabilities. This senior role combines hands-on algorithm development with technical leadership, research, and collaboration with internal businesses and government partners.

As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to power the energy transition. We forge the partnerships and invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.

Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 technology partners to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Research & Development: Develop high-impact technology concepts focused on computer vision algorithms, perception, and system-level integration.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead and contribute to system architecture, design, and software development lifecycles.
  • Strategic Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external thought leaders across the computer vision stack to identify and drive new applications and research initiatives.

Position Requirements

  • Education: PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 5+ years' applied experience, OR Master's Degree plus 8+ years' experience.
  • Technical Expertise: Demonstrated experience in at least three of the following:
    • Systems architecture, design, and integration.
    • Development of camera and sensor drivers.
    • Software engineering and architecture for complex systems.
    • Spatial Awareness: Robotic perception, SLAM, visual odometry, or 3D point cloud processing (e.g., PCL, Open3D).
    • System Integration: Architecture design, sensor fusion, and driver development for complex camera/lidar arrays
    • Simulation: Use of synthetic environments (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo) for model training and validation.
    • Hardware-in-the-loop: Integrating software into operational robotic systems or industrial hardware.
    • Perception & Learning: Advanced computer vision algorithms, deep learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow), and model optimization for edge deployment.

  • Development Proficiency: Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python.
  • Execution: Proven track record of delivering technical projects and integrating software into functional, real-world systems.
  • Compliance:
    • Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not provide sponsorship for work authorization visas at the Master's level, now or in the future, for this position vacancy
    • Must be 18 years or older.
    • Must be willing to undergo a drug test and background investigation.
    • Must be willing to work on-site in Niskayuna, NY.
    • You must submit your application via the Careers page at www.careers.gevernova.com to be considered.
Desired Characteristics

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate high-level customer requirements into actionable technical development strategies.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal and oral/written English communication skills, with an ability to present to diverse technical and executive audiences.
  • Innovation: Self-motivated and capable of working independently to pursue new, emerging technical domains within the computer vision field.

Note: We are interested in hiring across a range of experience levels. If you are interested in this role but feel your current experience level may be slightly under- or over-qualified, we still encourage you to apply. Our team prioritizes technical aptitude and a passion for solving complex, real-world problems, and we are committed to finding the right fit for your skills within our organization.

GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

companySlogan: Bobyard builds the best AI infrastructure for faster takeoffs and estimates across the construction trades.
descriptionHtml:
About Bobyard

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

Who We Are

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

About The Role

Contractors spend dozens of hours per project doing takeoffs by hand. You'll build the models that automate it, and they have to work on messy, real-world drawings. You'll have real autonomy to design, run, and ship.

What You'll Do

  • Build detection, segmentation, OCR, and reasoning models for construction drawings
  • Own pipelines end to end: ingestion, labeling, training, eval, and low-latency inference
  • Improve accuracy, robustness, and latency across a wide range of drawing formats
  • Ship to production with fullstack and product engineers
  • Dig into customer data to find and fix failure modes

What We're Looking For

  • Strong computer vision and deep learning background
  • You've trained and shipped models (segmentation, detection, document AI, or vision-language)
  • Production ML experience with real reliability requirements
  • Comfortable with messy data: scanned, handwritten, imperfect
  • Practical: you read the research, but you ship working code
  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and specialized experience

Nice to have

  • Document AI or OCR experience
  • Publications or open-source work in CV

A note on pace

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you'll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you'll fit in well.

What We Offer

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

  • $160,000–$230,000 base (depending on level) + $10,000–$30,000 bonus + 0.02%–0.06% equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
  • Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
  • Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!

Compensation Range: $160K - $230K

descriptionHtml:
About 3LC


3LC illuminates the black box of Physical AI model training. We build the first full-loop platform for AI data preparation and optimization, combining labeling, debugging, diagnosis, and curation so teams can ship better, smaller, faster models.


Across energy, agriculture, manufacturing, and aerospace, machines are learning to see the physical world: inspecting wind turbines, spotting crop disease, and checking parts on a manufacturing line. They can only see as well as the data they learn from, and that data is often messy. 3LC helps computer vision teams find and fix flaws in their training data so the systems built on it see the world more clearly and reliably; all within the customer's own infrastructure.


We are a team of 14, with colleagues across Norway and the US. Backed by several leading VC firms and growing fast, we offer the opportunity to take real ownership, work closely with customers, and help shape the product.


The Role


As an Applied AI Engineer at 3LC, you’ll work directly with customers, both in and on their infrastructure, to develop and improve computer vision models using 3LC. You’ll help turn real-world challenges into well-defined machine learning problems, understand where models fail, and develop efficient processes that support their use of ML and 3LC.


You’ll work across the ML pipeline, from exploring datasets and establishing baselines, to training, evaluating, and preparing models for production. Working with customer teams, you’ll focus on delivering high-quality Computer Vision ML results, building models, integrations, plugins, and workflows that align with their goals, and making ML and 3LC an effective part of their day-to-day work. You’ll also bring what you learn back into the product, improving our Python APIs and helping shape how 3LC supports practical ML work.


This position is based in our Boulder, Colorado office and requires working on-site. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available.


What You’ll Do


·      Work directly with customer teams to understand their challenges, infrastructure, and ML processes, define effective evaluation criteria, and establish model-performance baselines.

·      Develop, train, and improve computer vision models for tasks including object detection, segmentation, and classification.

·      Use 3LC to explore datasets, investigate failure cases, assess labels, and identify data improvements that make a measurable difference.

·      Develop efficient processes and workflows within customers’ infrastructure for data curation, training, evaluation, debugging, and monitoring.

·      Build and maintain integrations, plugins, and reusable tools that connect 3LC to customers’ ML systems and infrastructure, writing clean, well-tested Python code and improving 3LC’s platform and APIs.

·      Explain findings and trade-offs to customers, helping them understand what changed, why it matters, and what to try next.

·      Create reusable examples, benchmarks, and documentation so lessons from one project inform the next.

·      Stay current with relevant ML research and bring useful techniques to customer work and the product.


What We’re Looking For


·      Strong understanding of Machine Learning concepts, model approaches, and training techniques.

·      Strong Python skills and experience working in substantial codebases.

·      Hands-on experience building and improving Computer Vision models with PyTorch or comparable frameworks.

·      Practical experience preparing datasets, training models, evaluating results, and investigating failures.

·      A thoughtful approach to experimentation, including selecting meaningful metrics and evaluating whether improvements hold up.

·      An interest in data-centric AI and in how data quality, coverage, and labeling affect model behavior.

·      Strong communication skills and the ability to resolve technical problems with customers.

·      Initiative and follow-through, including comfort with working through ambiguity and taking responsibility for delivery.

·      Ability to work on-site at our Boulder office.


Nice to Have


·      Experience with real-world industrial computer vision or other applications involving challenging data.

·      Familiarity with tools such as YOLO, Detectron2, SAM3, and PyTorch.

·      Experience deploying or optimizing models, including ONNX or TensorRT.

·      Experience with cloud ML infrastructure with a strong focus on Azure.

·      Experience in customer-facing engineering, technical onboarding, or proof-of-concept delivery.

·      Experience with active learning, data quality tooling, embeddings, or data-drift monitoring.

·      Open-source contributions or projects that demonstrate your approach to practical ML problems.


Compensation & Benefits


·      Salary range: $110,000 – $140,000 per year, depending on experience, plus meaningful equity.


Benefits include:

·      Health, dental, and vision insurance.

·      401(k) retirement plan.

·      Paid time off (15 days / 3 weeks) plus company holidays.

·      Equity / stock options


This is a full-time, exempt position.


Why 3LC?


You’ll work closely with the people building the product and the teams using it. Your work will help customers solve real ML problems while directly informing what we build next.


We’re a small team across the US and Norway, with room to contribute ideas, take ownership, and see your work through.


How to Apply


Send your CV, a short note and a few examples of your work, infrastructure you've built, models you own, repos, or write-ups that show how you think, to careers@3lc.ai.


Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting will remain open until the position is filled.

No recruiters, please. We review every application personally.

descriptionHtml:
Computer Vision Engineer

US Remote


Hexagon Multivista, the leader in reality capture and automated analysis for the construction industry, is looking for a Senior or Staff Computer Vision Engineer to drive, and stay hands on with, the computer vision and machine learning work at the heart of our products. Most of this work is in our Analyze Hub product, which automatically tracks construction progress and detects deviations and clashes from reality-capture data; you will also own the SLAM and spatial-reconstruction work behind GoCapture, our mobile 360 reality-capture product, where smooth, accurate walk paths are everything.


Reporting to the Senior Director of Software Engineering and working alongside our Software Architect, you will partner day to day with two senior machine learning and computer vision engineers and help level up engineers across our teams. This is an individual contributor role, not a people-management one, but it carries real ownership: you build, and you also lead CV and ML projects end to end, holding the bar on the quality of results and pushing the work through to commercial release, often with help from people who do not report to you.


Above all, we want someone with a commercial, pragmatic mindset who cares about what it takes to make computer vision succeed in a real product, not just in a paper. If you love taking gnarly perception problems from prototype all the way to shipping product, and lifting a team as you go, this is the position for you.


What challenges will you get here:

  • Algorithmic Direction: Shape the technical direction of our computer vision and machine learning algorithms, and at the Staff level own the roadmap, balancing research ambition against the need to ship and making the calls on where to invest and where to keep things simple.
  • Hands-On Development: Spend a large share of your time in the code. You will design, implement, and optimize perception algorithms directly, not direct from a distance.
  • Commercial Pragmatism: Keep one eye firmly on the product. A typical example is taking a collection of off-the-shelf SLAM algorithms and experimenting with and improving them to hit our real product targets for path quality, runtime performance, and hosting cost, rather than chasing benchmark numbers in isolation.
  • Project Leadership: Lead CV and ML projects from first experiment through to commercial release. Turn open-ended research questions into a plan with clear milestones, success metrics, and quality bars agreed up front; keep the work visible; surface risks early; and know when to push on, change course, or stop. Research-heavy work is inherently uncertain, and we need someone who can still make it predictable enough to plan a product around.
  • Quality of Results: Own the quality of what we ship. Ensure algorithms are rigorously evaluated, benchmarked against ground truth, and hardened for accuracy, performance, and reliability at scale, so that results hold up on real reality-capture imagery from construction projects across more than 70 markets worldwide, not just on test sets.
  • Leading Without Authority: Get results through people who do not report to you. Shipping CV and ML work depends on product, platform, QA, data, and operations teams across Hexagon, and you will build the relationships, make clear asks, and follow through until the work lands. • Driving to Commercialization: Own the last mile. Push work past the prototype through production integration, release, and customer rollout, with a pragmatic eye on what is good enough to ship now and what can wait for the next iteration.
  • Analyze Hub Intelligence: Drive the computer vision and ML at the core of Analyze Hub, including automated construction-progress tracking by floor and trade, deviation and clash detection, and analysis of imagery and derived models. This is where most of the work lives.
  • SLAM and Spatial Reconstruction: Own the SLAM, pose estimation, and spatial-reconstruction pipelines that power GoCapture, so that 360 walk paths come out smooth and accurate across mobile and 360 hardware.
  • Algorithm and Technology Areas: Provide deep technical leadership across the algorithmic domains our products rely on: o Visual and visual-inertial SLAM, structure-from-motion, and multi-view geometry o Deep learning for detection, segmentation, and classification on large-scale image and video data o 3D reconstruction, point-cloud, and photogrammetry techniques o Camera calibration and sensor fusion across 360, DSLR, and mobile devices o UAV and aerial imagery, including photogrammetry and volumetric or earthwork analysis o Making research-grade models run efficiently and reliably in cloud and on-device settings
  • Security by Design: Be the advocate our algorithm work needs for security and data protection. Make the secure handling of customer imagery, models, and pipelines a first-class concern across Analyze Hub, GoCapture, and our other products, supporting our commitment to enterprise-grade security and our evolving compliance posture as we serve security-conscious enterprise and public-sector customers.
  • Mentorship: Working closely with our Software Architect and the Senior Director of Software Engineering, mentor and level up engineers across the teams, raising the bar on how we attack hard, open-ended problems, always with an eye toward getting things done.
  • AI Tooling Leadership: Together with our Software Architect, champion new AI-assisted development processes and tools, and help the whole engineering group get more out of them.
  • Breaking Through the Hard Parts: Traditional machine learning gets us a long way, but the work is often sticky and runs into corners quickly. You will be the person who breaks through the gnarly edge cases and the last few percent that stall real-world performance.
  • Prototyping: Build prototypes to prove out the feasibility of new approaches before committing the team to a full production implementation.
  • System Integration: Collaborate with Software Architects and platform teams to integrate algorithms into scalable, maintainable services and pipelines.
  • Customer Impact: Keep a sharp eye on real-world utility, translating customer needs into algorithmic capabilities that visibly delight users.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain clear documentation of algorithm designs, evaluation methodology, and data and model workflows.
  • Technical Publication: Help us build a stronger culture of sharing our work, through internal technical writing and external publication or patents where it makes sense.
  • Agile Practices: Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.


Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A Master’s or PhD in a computer vision or machine learning discipline is a strong plus.
  • 5+ years developing computer vision and/or machine learning algorithms (Senior), or 8+ years including a track record of setting algorithmic direction or leading technical work (Staff). We will level the role to match your experience.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in computer vision, including SLAM, structure-from-motion, multi view geometry, camera calibration, and 3D reconstruction.
  • Strong applied machine learning and deep learning experience (e.g., PyTorch or TensorFlow) for detection, segmentation, and classification on images and video. • Strong proficiency in both Python and C++, which our algorithm work relies on.
  • Solid grounding in the underlying mathematics: linear algebra, probability, optimization, and geometry.
  • A track record of taking algorithms from research or prototype through to production at scale, including evaluation, benchmarking, and performance optimization.
  • Experience leading CV or ML projects end to end, including planning, tracking, and delivering work that depended on people outside your reporting line.
  • A commercial, product-first mindset: you measure success by what ships and performs in the real world, not by benchmark scores or publications alone.
  • A solid understanding of security and data-protection considerations for machine learning and computer vision systems, and the drive to advocate for them.
  • Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS and GCP) and comfort deploying ML workloads.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to explain complex algorithmic trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiar with Git and Jira.
  • Advanced English (written and spoken).


ABOUT Hexagon Multivista

Hexagon Multivista, part of Hexagon AB, has been contracted on over 2 billion square feet of construction projects worldwide and is trusted by the industry’s leading companies to mitigate risk, create efficiencies, and deliver a higher level of project insight throughout a building’s lifecycle. We offer a full suite of visual construction documentation services on an intuitive cloud-based web application with local boots-on-the-ground support in over 70 international markets. Along with streaming webcams, professional facility management videos, and virtual walkthroughs, the company delivers interactive as builts by linking inspection-grade photos to architectural plans to capture every project with exceptional clarity. We have been in business for over 20 years and we have a steady track record of growth and profitability.


In addition to competitive compensation and an engaging and collaborative business culture, Hexagon Multivista offers a comprehensive package of benefits including Paid Time Off, 401k matching up to 6% of compensation, Medical, Dental, Vision, Healthcare FSA & HSA and no cost Life Insurance.


Other insurance options including accident, critical illness, hospital care, accidental D&D and short & long-term disability are available at reduced/negotiated costs. We also offer tuition reimbursement, commuter benefits, pre-paid legal counsel, low-cost identity protection and Employee & Family Assistance Program.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We comply with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA requirements.

descriptionHtml:
The Company

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone’s manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, an established European entity supporting regional business development, sales, and operations, and a deployment hub in the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

THE POSITION

Saildrone is applying modern machine learning and computer vision to autonomous vehicles operating in challenging, poorly observed environments. As a Perception Machine Learning Engineer, you will develop and deploy ML-based perception capabilities using real-world vehicle data.

You will work across model development, data, evaluation, and production deployment.

The Responsibilities

  • Develop machine-learning-based perception systems for autonomous vehicles.
  • Train, evaluate, and improve computer vision models using real-world sensor data.
  • Develop data and experimentation workflows to identify failure modes and improve model performance.
  • Build perception capabilities for detection, classification, segmentation, depth estimation, or scene understanding.
  • Analyze vehicle data and model failures to identify weaknesses and drive improvements.
  • Integrate models into production perception systems.
  • Bring new machine learning techniques from experimentation into deployed systems.

The Qualifications

  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Hands-on experience developing computer vision or machine learning systems.
  • Strong experience with PyTorch or a comparable ML framework.
  • Strong understanding of computer vision fundamentals and real-world visual data.
  • Experience evaluating models using quantitative metrics and experimental analysis.
  • Experience taking ML or computer vision systems into production.

NICE TO HAVE

  • C++ experience for production perception systems.
  • Robotics, autonomous vehicle, aerospace, or defense experience.
  • Edge or embedded ML deployment.
  • Sensor fusion, 3D perception, or multimodal perception.
  • ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA, or other inference optimization experience.

The base salary range for this position is shown below. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This range reflects the base salary for candidates in states requiring pay transparency disclosure.

Salary Range

$144,500—$300,000 USD

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

For details on how we process your data, please read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Benefits

At Saildrone, we’re building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team’s well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual plus a robust annual holiday schedule and paid sick leave ensure you can rest, reset, and sustain performance over time.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Premium, multi-tier Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with significant company contributions for employees and dependents—providing security and peace of mind.
  • Shared Ownership in the Mission: Equity grants are a core part of our compensation, allowing you to participate in the long-term value you help create through meaningful, operational work.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) retirement plan with flexible pre-tax and Roth payroll contribution options supports long-term financial planning.
  • Investment in Your Growth: We support your continuous learning through an annual professional development reimbursement program, empowering you to sharpen your skills and stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving field.
  • Relocation Support: For eligible roles, we offer relocation assistance to help bring the world’s best talent to our mission-critical locations.

Saildrone is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

descriptionHtml:
About Anyware

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.


The Role

The robots run on AnywareOS, our industrial physical intelligence system. Its architecture is modular and designed to generalize across applications without reprogramming. We are seeking a Staff AI Perception Engineer to advance Anyware's production 3D AI perception stack for warehouse automation robots, with a focus on object localization, pose estimation, scene reconstruction, and deployment on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.

This role is for an engineer who has taken AI perception from idea or prototype through production and real-world operation. You will make pragmatic tradeoffs across research potential, accuracy, reliability, latency, compute, data, maintainability, engineering effort, and delivery timelines, while providing senior technical leadership through architecture decisions, design reviews, incident investigations, and mentoring.

This is a hands-on Staff individual-contributor role with broad technical leadership responsibility. You will help shape the perception roadmap, set technical direction across projects, mentor engineers, and raise the team's technical capability through architecture decisions, design reviews, and hands-on implementation.


What you'll do

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership — set technical direction across perception projects, lead architecture and design reviews, mentor engineers, and help teams resolve difficult technical problems while remaining deeply involved in implementation and production debugging.
  • Define the perception architecture and technology roadmap — own senior-level architecture and design decisions for Anyware's production 3D AI perception stack, drive design reviews, and align the roadmap with product, customer, and cross-team release commitments.
  • Build and ship 3D AI perception on deployed robots, hands-on — develop robust object localization, pose estimation, and scene reconstruction pipelines using RGB-D and other sensing modalities, running on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.
  • Make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs across the robot system — balance accuracy, robustness, latency, compute cost, data availability, maintainability, and delivery timelines while integrating perception reliably with planning, manipulation, controls, and system software.


Required Skills

  • MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Vision, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing and deploying AI perception systems, with senior-level ownership of architecture and design decisions, balancing technical ambition with reliability, resources, maintainability, and delivery timelines.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership — setting technical direction, owning architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading design reviews or cross-functional technical execution. Direct people-management experience is not required.


Nice to have

  • Experience managing, hiring, or growing a technical team.
  • Strong foundation in 3D geometry, camera models and calibration, RGB-D or point-cloud processing, and 3D object localization, segmentation, or pose estimation.

descriptionHtml:
Intelligent machines powered by artificial intelligence—computers that can learn, reason, and interact with people—are transforming every industry. GPU-accelerated deep learning provides the foundation for machines to perceive, reason, and solve complex problems. NVIDIA GPUs run deep learning algorithms that simulate aspects of human intelligence, acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world.

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Perception Engineer to lead the design and productization of NVIDIA’s next-generation autonomous driving perception stack. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical leadership. You will set the technical direction for 3D obstacle perception, drive cross-functional execution, and mentor other engineers, while remaining deeply hands-on with architecture, algorithms, and implementation, including modern transformer-based, multi-modal, and vision-language techniques where they add real value.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for 3D obstacle perception to support end-to-end autonomous driving functionalities, leveraging state-of-the-art CNN and transformer-based architectures where appropriate.
  • Design and develop advanced 3D perception models using multi-camera inputs and/or multi-sensor fusion (camera, radar, lidar) for obstacle detection and tracking, including opportunities to explore BEV and transformer-based 3D perception.
  • Lead the development of efficient, production-grade deep learning models: define objectives, select architectures, guide experimentation, and establish best practices for training and evaluation, using techniques such as large-scale pretraining, distillation, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA).
  • Define and drive KPI frameworks to quantify perception performance; analyze large-scale real and synthetic datasets to identify failure modes and systematically improve accuracy, robustness, and efficiency, incorporating modern approaches like self-supervised and representation learning when beneficial.
  • Lead data strategy for perception: specify data and labeling requirements, prioritize data collection and annotation, and collaborate closely with data and ground-truth teams to maximize impact, including model-assisted workflows (e.g., active learning, auto-labeling, VLMs) and advanced model-in-the-loop tooling.
  • Partner with safety, systems, and software teams to ensure perception solutions meet stringent product requirements for safety, latency, resource usage, and software robustness, and are ready for deployment at scale.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, influencing design and implementation across the broader perception and autonomy teams.

What We Need To See

  • 15+ years of hands-on experience developing deep learning–based perception or closely related systems for complex real-world problems, with strong proficiency in frameworks such as PyTorch and a track record of taking models from prototype to production.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership as a senior or principal-level individual contributor: owning features or subsystems end-to-end, setting technical direction, making architectural decisions, and coordinating across teams.
  • Proven experience in data-driven development, including close collaboration with data, labeling, and ground-truth teams on data strategy, labeling quality, and iterative model improvement.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++, with a history of building reliable, high-performance, production-quality software.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive consensus across multidisciplinary teams.
  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Proven track record leading the design and deployment of perception solutions for autonomous driving or robotics using camera-based deep learning at scale.
  • Hands-on experience architecting and deploying DNN-based perception pipelines on embedded or real-time platforms, including optimization for latency, memory, and compute constraints, and experience with modern architectures such as CNNs and transformers, plus familiarity with techniques like large-scale pretraining, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), or vision-language models (VLMs).
  • Strong publication record or recognized contributions in deep learning, computer vision, or autonomous systems at leading conferences/journals (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, IROS).
  • Deep understanding of 3D computer vision fundamentals, including camera modeling and calibration (intrinsic and extrinsic), multi-view geometry, and 3D representations, ideally with experience applying these concepts in transformer-based 3D or BEV perception pipelines.
  • Experience with CUDA development and optimizing training or inference pipelines through custom CUDA kernels or other GPU-accelerated components.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 272,000 USD – 431,250 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

companyDescription: Bedrock Robotics brings advanced autonomy to the built world, helping the construction industry build at the pace today's society demands. Our technology upgrades existing heavy equipment, enabling truly autonomous operation with expert level quality and superhuman safety. At a time when we need to build faster than ever—from housing to data centers to factories and energy infrastructure—autonomous construction isn't just an innovation, it's an economic necessity.
companySlogan: Accelerating the work that builds our world.
descriptionHtml:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

Machine Learning Engineer: Perception

Bedrock is bringing autonomy to the construction industry! We’re a group of veterans from the autonomous vehicle industry who are passionate about bringing the benefits of automation to areas in the construction industry currently underserved by the market.

We are looking for engineers with expertise in shipping production 3D perception systems at scale. Successful candidates have architected systems, trained models from scratch, understand the full stack (clustering, detection, classification, and tracking), and have shipped at scale. We use both computer vision and LIDAR-based approaches, so knowledge of either or both is key. Models are just part of the system: you understand data and have good intuition about why models fail. You know how to evaluate corner cases, manage or build data pipelines, use auto-labels (or not), and have a strong understanding of statistical properties of these systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Design Early Fusion Architectures: Develop and train state-of-the-art models (e.g., BEV-based transformers) that fuse raw Lidar and Camera data to solve for object detection and semantic segmentation.
  • Tackle "Messy" Physics: Build perception systems robust enough to handle dynamic occlusion (seeing the robot’s own arm/bucket), particulates (dust, snow, rain), and high-vibration conditions.
  • Deploy to the Edge: Optimize models for inference on embedded hardware. You will debug system-level issues, such as sensor calibration drift and latency bottlenecks.
  • Collaborating with other teams to create state-of-the-art representations for downstream use cases.

What We're Looking For

  • Production ML Experience: 5+ years of experience taking deep learning models from research to real-world production using PyTorch, Tensorflow, or JAX.
  • 3D Geometry & Calibration: You have a deep understanding of SE(3) transformations, homogeneous coordinates, and intrinsic/extrinsic sensor calibration. You understand the math required to project a 3D Lidar point onto a 2D image pixel accurately.
  • Early Fusion Expertise: Practical experience with architectures that fuse modalities at the feature level (e.g., BEVFusion, TransFuser, PointPainting) rather than just fusing final bounding boxes.
  • SOTA Object Detection experience with modern transformer-based architectures (DETR, PETR, etc…) including similar temporal models (PETRv2, StreamPETR, …)
  • Systems Fluency: You are an expert in Python, but you are also comfortable reading and writing systems code in C++ or Rust. You understand memory management and real-time constraints.
  • Data Intuition: You understand that in robotics, better data alignment often beats a bigger model. You are willing to dig into the data infrastructure to ensure ground truth quality.

Ways To Stand Out

  • Bonus: Voxel/Occupancy Experience: Experience working with occupancy grids, NeRFs, or voxel-based representations for terrain mapping.
  • Bonus: Top-Tier Research: Published work in conferences such as ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, CoRL, or RSS

Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodations

We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.

descriptionHtml:
Perception Engineer


About the Role

We are seeking a Perception Engineer to develop, optimize, and deploy computer vision and sensing systems for autonomous platforms. This role spans the full perception pipeline, including camera and sensor evaluation, image processing, machine learning, embedded software deployment, and integration with real-time autonomy systems.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with a practical understanding of computer vision, optical sensing, and embedded systems. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on translating algorithms into reliable, production-ready systems that perform in real-world environments.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize computer vision, image-processing, and sensor-processing algorithms for real-time perception applications.
  • Evaluate cameras, lenses, and image sensors based on resolution, sensitivity, noise, dynamic range, and overall performance requirements.
  • Design and implement techniques for image enhancement, denoising, filtering, feature extraction, and object detection.
  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate machine learning models for object detection, classification, tracking, and state estimation.
  • Deploy and optimize perception software on embedded and edge-computing platforms.
  • Improve system performance by optimizing latency, throughput, and computational efficiency using GPU acceleration and related technologies.
  • Develop production-quality C++ software and integrate perception capabilities with robotics and autonomy frameworks.
  • Collect, analyze, and evaluate real-world data to identify performance gaps and improve perception systems.
  • Troubleshoot issues across the perception pipeline, including sensor performance, image quality, processing algorithms, and system integration.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure perception outputs meet system-level performance and reliability requirements.
  • Develop testing, benchmarking, and evaluation workflows to measure accuracy, robustness, and real-time performance.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field, with relevant industry or applied robotics experience; alternatively, a master's degree in a related discipline.
  • Experience developing computer vision, perception, image-processing, or sensor-processing systems.
  • Proficiency in C++ and experience developing performance-sensitive software.
  • Understanding of image-processing fundamentals, including filtering, denoising, contrast enhancement, feature extraction, or temporal analysis.
  • Experience developing, training, fine-tuning, or evaluating computer vision or machine learning models.
  • Familiarity with embedded systems, real-time computing, or software deployment under hardware and computational constraints.
  • Strong debugging and analytical skills, with an emphasis on data-driven evaluation and measurable performance improvements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating cameras, lenses, optical systems, or image sensors.
  • Familiarity with sensor characteristics, including pixel size, sensitivity, exposure, noise, dynamic range, and resolution.
  • Experience deploying computer vision or machine learning applications on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson.
  • Knowledge of CUDA, TensorRT, GPU programming, or performance profiling and optimization.
  • Experience with ROS 2 or other robotics middleware.
  • Background in sensor fusion, visual-inertial systems, or multimodal perception involving cameras, radar, or LiDAR.
  • Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, unmanned aerial systems (UAS), or field testing.
  • Familiarity with dataset development, data labeling, model evaluation metrics, and regression testing.
  • Experience transitioning computer vision algorithms from research and prototyping into production-ready software.

About Duranta & What We’re Looking For

Duranta is an applied AI lab changing the way the world sees the world. Our flagship foundation computer vision model, Aidan, measures and understands the world in 4D, redefining how industries interact with the physical world through Artificial Spatial Intelligence. Duranta’s founding team have built unicorns, had successful exits and published groundbreaking research within the field of computer vision. We are seeking a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to join our team.

Who You'll Be Working With

  • Dr. Amir Zamir - maker of 4M, Taskonomy, FlexToK, winner of Best Paper award (CVPR, SIGGRAPH)
  • Dr. Konrad Schindler - maker of Marigold, MOTChallenge, winner of the Frederick J. Doyle Award and Best Paper award candidates (CVPRW, ISPRS)
  • Dr. Romann Bachmann - maker of MultiMAE, collaborator on MODUS, winner young investigator award
  • A team of engineers and scientists with backgrounds from University of Toronto, Stanford, EPFL, ASU and NYU

You will also work closely with the founding team on deep learning research and deployment across semantic and instance segmentation, few-shot learning, 3D reasoning and generative modeling. Specifically, you will be responsible for contributing to the development of our computer vision pipelines for extracting comprehensive intelligence from optical imagery.

Responsibilities & Focus Areas

  • Building the components of a state-of-the-art computer vision pipeline for our AI system
  • Build and improve CV models (e.g., Mask2Former, SAM, ViT, Swin) for aerial and oblique imagery
  • Run experiments at scale with deep learning frameworks like PyTorch
  • Develop and maintain clean, modular ML infrastructure
  • Collaborate on model deployment and inference optimizations
  • Read and reproduce ideas from latest papers (CVPR, NeurIPS and other similar top-tier venues)

YOU WILL THRIVE IF YOU HAVE

  • Have 5+ years experience in ML / deep learning, ideally in Computer Vision
  • Have strong coding ability (Python, PyTorch)
  • Have trained segmentation/detection models on real-world data at scale
  • Have experience with generative modeling and large foundation models
  • Have worked in startups or fast-moving teams and can wear many hats

AND FOR EXTRA CREDIT…

  • Experience with high-res aerial/remote sensing imagery and LiDAR
  • Experience with self-supervised and weakly-supervised learning
  • Knowledge of 3D, CAD and computer graphics
  • Experience with cloud computing (e.g., AWS)

DURANTA VALUES

  • API = Assume Positive Intent. Our company, your relationship with co-workers and customers, and life is so much better and more fun if you follow this rule.
  • Speed is the Essence. We are in a hurry to make a difference.
  • Expect Peak Performance. We strive for excellence and empower those around us to do the same.
  • Build something beautiful. A beautiful product, a beautiful company, and a more beautiful world.

$160,000 - $275,000 a year

  • equity

Note: Base salary & equity will depend largely on leveling.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
