descriptionHtml:
Aquent is partnering with an innovative technology company at the forefront of autonomous mobility, developing advanced software and artificial intelligence systems that are transforming the future of transportation. This organization is focused on building safe, reliable, and scalable autonomous technologies through cutting-edge machine learning, computer vision, and distributed software systems. Join a collaborative engineering environment where your technical expertise will directly contribute to advancing how autonomous systems perceive, understand, and navigate the world.


We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer, Fleet Mapping to contribute to the development of sophisticated mapping technologies that support next-generation autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will help design, develop, validate, and integrate machine learning models that identify important semantic features within complex environments. You will work on scalable, offline mapping pipelines that automate the detection and mapping of new features, helping improve the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of autonomous navigation systems.

The ideal candidate brings strong C++ software engineering experience, a solid understanding of networking protocols, and experience building highly resilient distributed systems. Experience with robotics, computer vision, or mapping technologies is highly valued.


What You'll Do


  • Research, develop, implement, and train machine learning models to detect and classify semantic map elements used in autonomous navigation.
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of high-definition semantic mapping systems that support autonomous vehicle perception.
  • Design, develop, and integrate software components into scalable, offline mapping pipelines.
  • Drive automation of new mapping features to improve mapping efficiency, scalability, and accuracy.
  • Curate, organize, validate, and label datasets used for machine learning model training and evaluation.
  • Collaborate with engineering and validation teams to establish comprehensive model testing and validation pipelines.
  • Leverage machine learning infrastructure and development tools to accelerate model training, experimentation, integration, and deployment.
  • Develop and optimize C++ software components supporting high-performance mapping and distributed processing systems.
  • Work with networking technologies and communication protocols to support reliable data exchange across distributed engineering systems.
  • Identify and resolve performance, scalability, reliability, and integration challenges within complex software environments.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, machine learning researchers, and cross-functional technical teams to deliver production-quality mapping capabilities.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, technical documentation, and continuous improvements to mapping systems and development workflows.


What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications


  • 5+ years of professional software development experience using C++.
  • Strong understanding of networking protocols and network communication principles, ideally including UDP.
  • Experience designing, developing, or maintaining highly resilient distributed systems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including debugging, performance optimization, testing, and system reliability.
  • Ability to work effectively with complex software architectures and integrate new functionality into existing engineering systems.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical challenges across interconnected systems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working with cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate technical ambiguity, and contribute effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment.


Bonus Qualifications


  • Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, or autonomous navigation technologies.
  • Experience with 3D computer vision, image processing, or perception systems.
  • Familiarity with high-definition maps, semantic mapping, or automated mapping pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience developing, training, or validating machine learning models.
  • Experience with semantic feature detection, object recognition, or environmental understanding.
  • Experience working with large datasets, including data curation, labeling, and validation.
  • Familiarity with machine learning infrastructure, model deployment, and production ML workflows.
  • Experience with LiDAR, point clouds, or other 3D sensor data.
  • Experience with scalable data processing pipelines and high-performance computing environments.

ML/CV Engineer

Organisation Overview

Our Client is developing advanced AI technology for the healthcare sector, helping modernise surgical and procedural environments through computer vision, intelligent automation and real-time operational insight.

The organisation combines research-led innovation with practical deployment, creating systems designed to operate safely and reliably in demanding clinical settings. Employees benefit from a collaborative engineering culture, opportunities for continuous development, comprehensive healthcare options, paid leave and access to a retirement plan.

Role Summary

Our Client is seeking an ML/CV Engineer to take computer vision and deep learning models from successful prototypes into production on embedded hardware used in hospital environments.

This is a high-impact position with ownership extending beyond initial deployment. You will optimise models for real-world hardware constraints, establish robust retraining and release processes, monitor performance in the field and manage carefully controlled updates across deployed devices.

Working alongside research, embedded software and quality engineering teams, you will help turn advanced machine learning capability into dependable, scalable products used within critical healthcare workflows.

Responsibilities


  • Deploy computer vision and deep learning models to embedded accelerators, applying techniques such as quantisation, pruning, operator fusion and graph optimisation.
  • Analyse inference performance on target hardware and improve kernels, memory use, batching and processing schedules to meet defined latency and throughput requirements.
  • Develop and maintain reproducible pipelines for model training, evaluation, packaging and release.
  • Create automated regression testing processes using appropriately held-out clinical datasets.
  • Add monitoring for inference latency, resource consumption and prediction behaviour across deployed systems.
  • Investigate model drift, unexpected behaviour and performance deterioration on devices in the field.
  • Plan and execute phased model releases, including shadow testing, approval criteria and rollback processes.
  • Manage retraining programmes from data selection and labelling requirements through to validation and release evidence.
  • Collaborate with research engineers to make experimental models suitable for production use.
  • Work with embedded software teams to support efficient hardware deployment.
  • Partner with quality engineering to prepare documentation and evidence for regulated product releases.
  • Maintain ownership of model performance and lifecycle management following deployment.

Essential Skills & Experience


  • At least four years' professional experience developing and deploying computer vision or deep learning models.
  • Experience taking at least one machine learning model into production on embedded or edge hardware.
  • Strong production programming experience using both Python and C++.
  • Practical knowledge of inference runtimes and optimisation tools, such as TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, TFLite or comparable embedded accelerator SDKs.
  • Experience applying model compression methods, including post-training quantisation, quantisation-aware training, pruning and knowledge distillation.
  • Understanding of how optimisation and compression techniques affect model accuracy and operational performance.
  • Experience working with embedded compute platforms, such as NVIDIA Jetson, Arm-based systems, GPUs, DSPs or NPUs.
  • Ability to profile and troubleshoot machine learning workloads on target hardware.
  • Demonstrable experience managing models after release, including version control, monitoring, retraining and controlled production rollout.
  • Candidates must be based in the United States and already authorised to work there.
  • Our Client is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Desirable Skills & Experience

The following would strengthen an application but are not essential:


  • Experience delivering software within a regulated medical device environment.
  • Familiarity with design controls, verification and validation activities.
  • CUDA or other GPU kernel development for custom operators.
  • Experience with video capture, real-time streaming or hardware-accelerated video processing on embedded platforms.
  • Knowledge of MLOps tools for experiment tracking, dataset versioning and model registries.
  • Experience with containerised deployment and CI/CD for embedded or fleet-managed devices.
  • A postgraduate qualification in computer science, electrical engineering or a related discipline.

Apply Now

If you have proven experience deploying and maintaining computer vision models on embedded hardware, please submit your CV for consideration. This opportunity is particularly suited to engineers who enjoy bridging research, software engineering and reliable real-world deployment.

Disclaimer: Any remuneration stated in this advertisement is indicative and will be dependent on the successful candidate's experience, skills and qualifications. Final remuneration will be agreed with the successful candidate and will be subject to the terms of the contract.

Job Summary

The Pan Lab at the Huntsman Cancer Institute (HCI), University of Utah is seeking a highly motivated computational researcher to join our interdisciplinary research team. Our lab develops artificial intelligence (AI) and computational approaches to study cancer using digital pathology and multi-omics data, with an emphasis on translating quantitative tissue phenotypes into biologically and clinically meaningful insights.

We are particularly interested in candidates with strong computational skills in computer vision, deep learning, image processing, and scientific programming. The successful candidate will work primarily on computational pathology and multimodal cancer research, including analysis of whole-slide histopathology images and integration of imaging-derived features with spatial, molecular and clinical data.

The Pan Lab is based at Huntsman Cancer Institute and the Department of Oncological Sciences at the University of Utah. Our research lies at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computational pathology, spatial biology, and precision oncology.

The successful candidate will have opportunities to work with large-scale digital pathology and molecular datasets, develop new computational methodology, collaborate across computational, biological, pathological, and clinical disciplines, and contribute to high-impact translational cancer research.

Huntsman Cancer Institute is committed to cancer prevention, care, and survivorship for all communities within the area we serve – which includes Idaho, Montana, Nevada, Utah, and Wyoming – with impact worldwide.

In your cover letter or during your interview process, we invite you to share how your professional experiences have prepared you to serve as a member of our team as we work to reduce the cancer burden experienced by all people and communities. This may include description of your prior experiences related to research, prevention, clinical care, community engagement/outreach, training, administration, or other areas relevant to Huntsman Cancer Institute's mission and this position.

Learn more about the great benefits of working for University of Utah: benefits.utah.edu

The department may choose to hire at any of the below job levels and associated pay rates based on their business need and budget.

Responsibilities

Research Areas and Responsibilities

The Successful Candidate Will Contribute To Projects Involving

  • Development and application of computer vision and deep learning methods for pathology images, including tissue and cellular segmentation, classification, and quantitative image analysis.
  • Development and maintenance of scalable and reproducible computational pipelines for large pathology and multi-omics datasets.
  • Characterization of tumor morphology, tissue architecture, immune and stromal microenvironments, and spatial heterogeneity.
  • Integration of digital pathology with spatial transcriptomics, spatial proteomics, and other molecular data.
  • Development of multimodal approaches for biomarker discovery, patient stratification, and outcome prediction.
  • Analysis of large datasets using Linux-based high-performance and GPU computing environments.
  • Collaboration with bioinformatician, pathologists, cancer biologists, and clinical investigators to design analyses and interpret results.
  • Preparation of scientific manuscripts and presentation of research findings at internal meetings and national/international conferences.

How To Apply Interested Applicants Should Submit

  • A CV with links to GitHub repositories or Hugging Face if available.
  • A cover letter describing research experience, computational expertise, and research interests (1-page);
  • Contact information for three references.

Applicants are encouraged to highlight their experience with Python, Linux, computer vision/image processing, computational pathology, and/or multi-omics analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

EQUIVALENCY STATEMENT: 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor's degree = 4 years of directly related work experience).

Department may hire employee at one of the following job levels:

Research Scientist, I: Requires a PhD in a scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and directly related experience.

Preferences

Preferred Candidates Have

  • A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree, or substantial relevant research experience, in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Strong programming skills in Python.
  • Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment, including command-line workflows.
  • Experience in image processing, computer vision, deep learning, and/or large language models.
  • Familiarity with modern deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Ability to independently develop, debug, and maintain scientific analysis pipelines.
  • Strong quantitative problem-solving skills and the ability to learn new computational methods independently.
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

  • Computational pathology.
  • Deep learning for image segmentation, classification, object detection, representation learning, or related computer-vision tasks.
  • Spatial transcriptomics or spatial proteomics, including platforms such as 10x Visium or Xenium.
  • Multimodal machine learning and image-omics integration.
  • High-performance/GPU computing, workload schedulers, containers, and reproducible computational environments.
  • Scientific productivity demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, software, or other research outputs.

Candidates are not expected to have experience in all of these areas. We particularly value strong computational fundamentals, rigorous problem-solving skills, scientific curiosity, and the ability to independently learn new methods.

The HMS Perception team develops sensor-processing, vision, tracking, sensor-fusion, and AI/ML capabilities that provide reliable information to autonomous systems. We evaluate work with real and simulated sensor data and integrate outputs into mission software.

As an Engineer II, you will deliver bounded perception features and evaluation improvements using established technical direction. You will diagnose moderately defined algorithm, data, and software issues, bring changes through tests and documentation, and coordinate on your assigned interfaces. Senior engineers will guide subsystem architecture and cross-program technical decisions.

What you'll do

  • Implement and test C++ changes in detection, tracking, fusion, localization support, data pipelines, or AI/ML-enabled perception workflows.
  • Work with real and simulated EO/IR, camera, radar, IMU, GPS, or other sensor data to evaluate performance and failure modes.
  • Build tests, metrics, analysis scripts, and visualizations to make algorithm behavior measurable and repeatable.
  • Support integration of perception outputs with autonomy behaviors, mission systems, and operator interfaces under defined contracts.
  • Debug data quality, timing, coordinate frames, software interfaces, and model or algorithm behavior with guidance as needed.
  • Participate in simulation, lab, and field-test preparation and post-test analysis for assigned work.
  • Document design assumptions, evaluation results, and issues; collaborate with perception, autonomy, platform, and test teammates.

descriptionHtml:
Multimodal AI Scientist – L&T Group AI Center of Excellence

Santa Clara, California |L&T Group-wide (US and India)| 8–15 years |Reports to: Head, AI CoE

About the Role

Build multimodal AI systems that reason jointly over vision, language, audio, sensor, time-series, and 3D data to solve real problems across L&T's engineering, manufacturing, infrastructure, energy, and defence businesses. You will bridge foundation-model research and production engineering, working closely with Robotics, Computer Vision, and Language Model teams to build reusable models and pipelines.

What You'll Do

  • Design, train, and adapt vision-language and sensor-fusion models for engineering drawings, inspection imagery, P&IDs, video, and IoT telemetry.
  • Partner with business units on high-value use cases, such as visual inspection with natural-language reporting, drawing understanding, and digital twin enrichment.
  • Take proofs of concept through pilot to production, with defined success metrics and quantified business impact.
  • Define data collection and annotation strategies, and build scalable pipelines for video, point clouds, and sensor streams.
  • Set benchmarks for accuracy, robustness, hallucination, and safety, and optimize models for latency and edge deployment.
  • Mentor engineers, contribute to the CoE repository, and publish papers or file patents.

First 12 Months

  • Define the multimodal AI technical roadmap and reference architecture for the CoE.
  • Deliver 3–5 multimodal proofs of concept, at least two scaled to pilot or production.
  • Publish reusable model and pipeline assets, plus an evaluation and benchmarking framework.

What We're Looking For

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (PhD preferred).
  • 8–15 years in machine learning or AI, including at least 4 years in multimodal, vision-language, or foundation-model work and a record of taking models to production.
  • Deep expertise in transformers, diffusion models, contrastive learning, and cross-attention fusion.
  • Strong Python with PyTorch, JAX, or Hugging Face; distributed GPU training experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP; familiarity with RAG and multimodal retrieval.
  • Experience with industrial, engineering, or physical-world data is strongly preferred. Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, or ACL are a plus.

descriptionHtml:
At Greene, Tweed, you'll find the cutting-edge technology, world-class polymer expertise and endless advancement opportunities you'd expect from a multi-national industry leader. You'll find them all in an environment that embraces diversity in people and opinions, moves decision making to the point of impact, and celebrates your success.

If you enjoy continuous learning and are excited about working with and creating technological solutions, explore career opportunities with Greene, Tweed.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:  

  • Lead the design, development, integration, and deployment of machine vision systems for manufacturing and production applications.
  • Determine appropriate camera, lens, lighting, optics, image acquisition, processing, and system architecture for each application.
  • Program and configure smart camera systems, including Cognex, Keyence and other industrial smart-camera platforms
  • Design and implement systems using GigE Vision cameras,
  • Evaluate and apply traditional rules-based machine vision techniques as well as modern deep-learning-based vision approaches where appropriate.
  • Develop inspection algorithms for applications including (but not limited to):
    • Defect detection

    • OCR/OCV

    • Presence/absence verification

    • Dimensional & Surface inspection

    • Pattern and feature recognition
    • Develop, train, evaluate, and deploy machine-learning/deep-learning models for challenging inspection applications when conventional vision techniques are insufficient.
    • Integrate vision systems with PLCs, robots, motion systems, databases, MES systems, and other factory automation equipment.
    • Perform system debugging, image analysis, root-cause analysis, and optimization of existing inspection systems.
    • Establish and validate inspection performance, including false-positive/false-negative analysis, repeatability, reproducibility, and capability.
    • Develop documentation including system specifications, software documentation, inspection standards, validation procedures, and operator instructions.
    • Support equipment commissioning, production launch, and troubleshooting at manufacturing facilities.
    • Serve as a technical resource for machine vision technology, application development, and inspection-system design.

    Required Minimum Qualifications

    Education/Certifications: 

    • B.S. degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.
    • A3 Certified Vision Professional (CVP-Basic or CVP-Advanced), or similar professional certification
    • 10+ years of experience developing and deploying industrial machine vision systems, preferably in automated inspection applications.

    Technical:

    • Strong understanding of machine vision fundamentals
    • Ability to select cameras, lenses, lighting, and other optical components based on application requirements.
    • Ability to read and understand electrical, mechanical, and system-level documentation.
    • Demonstrated experience with multiple machine vision platforms and technologies.

    • Experience with Cognex and/or Keyence smart-camera systems and their associated software platforms.

    • Experience with GigE Vision cameras and associated image acquisition software/hardware.
    • Experience with deep learning for machine vision, including platforms such as Cognex Vision Pro Deep Learning, YOLO, or comparable object-detection/classification frameworks.
    • Experience with industrial GigE cameras from manufacturers such as Basler, FLIR, Allied Vision, IDS, or similar.
    • Experience with GenICam / GenTL and camera configuration.
    • Strong programming or scripting skills and the ability to work with vision-system APIs and software development environments.
    • Experience with image-processing libraries and programming environments such as C# & Python
    • Experience with industrial communications protocols such as EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, TCP/IP, OPC UA, or similar.
    • Experience with robotic vision applications.
    • Experience with precision measurement and dimensional inspection.
    • Experience with multi-camera inspection systems.
    • Experience with statistical analysis, GR&R, process capability, and inspection-system validation.
    • Experience working within regulated or highly controlled manufacturing environments.

    • Hands-on and comfortable working directly with equipment.
    • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
    • Comfortable learning new technologies and working across multiple vendor platforms.
    • Detail-oriented, particularly when developing systems where small changes can significantly affect inspection performance.
    • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
    • Able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Willingness and ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers and technicians.
    • Ability to travel (domestic & international) up to 5%, varying depending on demand.

A U.S. Person includes U.S. Citizens, U.S. Nationals, lawful permanent residents, and workers granted refugee or asylum status in the United States.

descriptionHtml:
At Senra Systems, we're building a new model for complex manufacturing, starting with electrical wire harnesses. We're a real manufacturer, not a lab: we build harnesses on our own production lines for some of the largest aerospace and defense companies in the country. Long term, automating this work is how we help bring complex manufacturing back to the U.S.


We're looking for a Senior Engineer to own the technical implementation of the data and perception layer in our Automation Program: the cameras, sensors, pipelines, and models that turn what happens on our production lines into data our factory software, our industrial engineers, and our robots can use. High-mix assembly has long resisted automation partly because the work is hard to see and measure. You'll change that: instrument the line, build the data infrastructure behind it, and build the perception our robotic cells and our robot learning work depend on. Real hardware, on a real line, in real production.


This is a hands-on senior role on a small team with aggressive goals. You'll report to one of Senra's cofounders, our Head of AI & Robotics, who owns the technical vision for the program. You'll partner with the other senior engineers on the team to execute it, and help shape where it goes as we build. It's a lot of work, with a lot of ownership, and what you build goes onto the line fast.


Everything else builds on this foundation. Our production robotics team uses it for sensing and inspection on the line, our robot learning team uses it to collect demonstrations and train new manipulation skills, and our industrial engineering team uses it to measure and improve manufacturing processes. As new capabilities are developed, they can be deployed directly back into production.


What you'll own:

  • Instrumentation of the line: cameras and sensors at workstations and in cells, capture software, and edge hardware that runs reliably on the floor
  • The factory data layer: pipelines and storage for video, sensor, and robot data, tied to jobs, operations, and parts in our in-house factory software
  • Perception in production: computer vision for inspection, step and activity recognition, part and wire detection, and cell sensing
  • Automated measurement: time studies, step logs, and photo records generated from the data, feeding planning, pricing, and quality
  • Data for robot learning: demonstration capture, labeling, datasets, and evaluation infrastructure, built with our Senior Robotics Engineer, Robot Learning
  • Data governance and security: technician consent, access control, and handling of export-controlled and customer data
  • Engineering standards, and evaluation of vendors and platforms where buying beats building
  • Helping hire and mentor the engineers who join as the team grows

What you'll bring to the team:

Required:

  • Hands-on experience building data infrastructure or perception systems that run in production, including systems where you were the technical lead
  • Computer vision in the physical world: training, deploying, and monitoring models on camera data from manufacturing, robotics, logistics, or similar settings
  • Data engineering for large volumes of video and sensor data: capture, pipelines, storage, labeling, and the tooling to train and evaluate on it
  • Experience with cameras and sensors on real hardware: selection, calibration, synchronization, and edge compute
  • Strong Python and SQL, a deep learning framework such as PyTorch, and comfort deploying to cloud and edge; C++ where performance needs it
  • A track record of moving quickly: rapid prototyping, testing on real hardware, and iterating to reliable results
  • Self-starter who takes ownership of a technical area end to end, partners well with other senior engineers, and communicates clearly with technicians, engineers, and leadership
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical or computer engineering, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Must be a U.S. Person as defined under ITAR (see ITAR requirements below)

Preferred:

  • Data infrastructure for robot learning: teleoperation or demonstration capture, dataset management, and evaluation
  • Activity or step recognition from video, or automated time study
  • Integration with manufacturing systems (e.g., MES, ERP) or factory software
  • Working with export-controlled or regulated data (e.g., ITAR, CUI, CMMC)
  • Experience in wire harness, cable assembly, or other high-mix assembly
  • Startup or high-growth company experience
  • Experience mentoring engineers or helping build a team

Success in This Role Looks Like (6–12 Months):

  • Cameras and capture are running at our highest-volume workstations, with data tied to jobs and operations in our factory software
  • Automated time studies or step logs from that data are informing planning and pricing
  • At least one perception model is running in production, such as camera inspection at a station or sensing in robotic cells, with measured accuracy
  • Our robot learning work is collecting demonstrations and training on data from your pipeline, under a technician consent policy
  • You've helped shape the technical roadmap with our Head of AI & Robotics and helped hire the next engineers on the team

We're also hiring a Senior Robotics Engineer, Production, and a Senior Robotics Engineer, Robot Learning. If your background sits between roles, apply to any of them and tell us.

Compensation:

  • Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.
  • Salary Range: $180,000-$230,000
  • This is an onsite role based at our Cypress, CA facility, with regular time at our Redondo Beach, CA facility

Benefits:

  • Unmatched opportunities to drive impact on a friendly and mission-driven team
  • Own a piece of the pie with equity participation!
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and long-term disability coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Spending Account (DSA) for health-related expenses
  • 20 vacation days per year and 12 company holidays for rest and relaxation
  • a 401(k) plan to set yourself up for retirement
  • Choose a record you love, and we’ll add it to our growing vinyl collection!
  • $50/month DoorDash credit – lunch is on us!
  • Up to $100/month reimbursement for gym memberships
  • Fully stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages
  • Regular team-building events, lunches, and the occasional breakfast burrito!
  • Bright, open office with communal spaces for collaboration and free parking
  • Conveniently located near the metro, major freeways and local dining spots

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Contact us at jobs@senrasystems.us or visit our website https://senrasystems.us.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

About Stack

Stack is developing revolutionary AI and advanced autonomous systems designed to enhance safety, reliability, and efficiency of modern operations. Stack's autonomous technology incorporates cutting-edge advancements in artificial intelligence, robotics, machine learning, and cloud technologies, empowering us to create innovative solutions that address the needs and challenges of the dynamic trucking transportation industry. With decades of experience creating and deploying real world systems for demanding environments, the Stack team is dedicated to developing an autonomous solution ecosystem tailored to the trucking industry's unique demands.

If you are an Internal Candidate, please apply via our Internal Job Board.

About The Role

The Perception Architecture team is responsible for tackling complex, cross-cutting issues in Stack AV’s approach to perception development and accelerating our delivery of perception capabilities. Many problems in the self-driving trucking industry are not well represented in the literature, requiring novel approaches or formulations to tackle challenging perception problems for the product.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop foundational ML architecture and systematic approaches to challenging, cross-cutting perception problems to ensure the self-driving system scales robustly and efficiently. This role will work closely with other teams to identify pain points and forward looking challenges, develop novel experiments to define future direction, and collaborate with other AI teams to convert these discoveries into products.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the technical direction of the Perception Architecture team and the broader perception organization.
  • Design and develop core machine learning components and architectures that enable the perception system to scale and reliably address complex, long-tail driving scenarios.
  • Drive the initial implementation and prototyping of key architectural decisions, such as handling long tail challenges or long range detection.
  • Contribute to the improvement of model frameworks, architecture, and data pipelines to eliminate development bottlenecks and accelerate model iteration.
  • Lead challenging technical topics and build consensus across sister teams (e.g., Actor Detection, Scene Understanding, Tracking) and stakeholders to ensure autonomy-wide alignment.

Qualifications

  • BS (with 4+ years of experience), MS (with 2+ years of experience), or PhD (with 1+ years of experience) in a perception-related field, such as Robotics, Computer Vision, or Machine Learning.
  • Extensive experience architecting, training, and evaluating deep learning models for challenging problem spaces.
  • Track record of driving applied research or engineering projects from conception and experimentation to successful productization.
  • Strong experience in software engineering, machine learning algorithm design, and building data/metrics pipelines for ML development.
  • Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with C++.
  • Experience delivering detection, segmentation, tracking, or other perception solutions for real-time robotic applications, with prior experience in sensor fusion being highly desirable.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We believe that diverse teams produce the best ideas and outcomes. We are committed to building a culture of inclusion, entrepreneurship, and innovation across gender, race, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability, and identity.

Check out our Privacy Policy.

Please Note: Pursuant to its business activities and use of technology, Stack AV complies with all applicable U.S. national security laws, regulations, and administrative requirements, which can restrict Stack AV’s ability to employ certain persons in certain positions pursuant to a range of national security-related requirements. As such, this position may be contingent upon Stack AV verifying a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status. This position may also involve working with software and technologies subject to U.S. export control regulations. Under these regulations, it may be necessary for Stack AV to obtain a U.S. government export license prior to releasing its technologies to certain persons. If Stack AV determines that a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status will require a license, prohibit the candidate from working in this position, or otherwise be subject to national security-related restrictions, Stack AV expressly reserves the right to either consider the candidate for a different position that is not subject to such restrictions, on whatever terms and conditions Stack AV shall establish in its sole discretion, or, in the alternative, decline to move forward with the candidate’s application.

descriptionHtml:
Lead Computer Vision Researcher


Our client is a prominent employee owned defense technology firm specializing in sophisticated security solutions for national interests. They are currently seeking a talented Computer Vision Scientist to join their technical team in Falls Church Virginia. This role focuses on the development and implementation of advanced algorithms for image analysis and scene understanding to support critical national security missions.


In this position you will design and refine workflows for object detection classification and 3D reconstruction. You will be responsible for evaluating algorithm performance creating custom metrics and identifying the root causes of technical errors to implement effective solutions. The work involves prototyping emerging computer vision technologies and adapting Python codebases to enhance imagery visualization and processing.


Key Responsibilities


Create algorithms for image processing and scene understanding

Develop and maintain Python based tools for data visualization

Quantify algorithm strengths and weaknesses through rigorous testing

Prepare technical briefings and high quality graphics for stakeholders

Collaborate with senior scientific staff to meet project milestones

Adapt to diverse technical roles across multiple project types


Required Qualifications


Current Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility is mandatory

Degree in Physics Engineering Mathematics or Computer Science

Strong proficiency in Python and standard image processing libraries

Hands on experience with modern computer vision frameworks

Background in research related to sensor data or machine learning

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear writing

United States citizenship is required


Preferred Skills


Experience with Vision Language Models or Foundation Models

Knowledge of 3D modeling and MLOps

Familiarity with C plus plus or CUDA for GPU acceleration

Experience with Synthetic Aperture Radar or satellite imagery

Understanding of cloud computing tools like AWS Docker and Kubernetes

Knowledge of detection and tracking estimation algorithms


Compensation and Benefits


The salary for this position is tiered based on experience levels. Candidates with two to five years of experience or an advanced degree can expect a range between 110,000 and 165,000 dollars annually.


The company provides an exceptional benefits package designed to support long term financial and personal well being.


Company funded 5 percent contribution to 401k

Company funded 5 percent contribution to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan

Comprehensive medical dental and vision coverage

Flexible work scheduling and generous paid time off

Parental leave and bereavement leave

Tuition assistance for continuing education

Fitness and vision reimbursement programs


This is a full time exempt position located in an office setting. Our client is an equal opportunity employer committed to workforce diversity and an inclusive professional environment. All candidates must pass a criminal background check and a drug screen as part of the onboarding process.
